liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer got chills from the jam and crowd energy at the end of Deal [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Wang Dang Doodle**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 6 archived performances [16]
- **Werewolves of London**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 13 archived performances [16]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Jack Straw, New Speedway Boogie, Brown Eyed Women, Ramble On Rose, Althea, Cassidy, Deal, Truckin', Estimated Prophet, Eyes of the World, Lady with a Fan, Terrapin Station and more [16]

## The recordings

- **deadandcompany2015-10-31.schoeps-44.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 204 min [1]
- **Dc20151031.14.eyesOfTheWorld**: source not stated; 22 songs; 202 min; rated 4.85/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it a really good audience recording, and notes that soundboards of this tour seem unlikely to be released; Reviewer says the recording is clear enough to hear every player, and everyone is playing well; Reviewer describes the recording as super clean [6][11][12]
- **DeadCo2015.10.31.audmtx**: source not stated; 23 songs; 202 min [3]

## Around the show

- The taping position was about 30 feet from the stage, dead center, with the mics on a stand at head height [2]
- Reviewer says the Halloween night crowd was blown away, and Oteil's added funk helped the band feed off each other [4]
- Reviewer attended both Madison Square Garden shows and praises John Mayer's guitar playing and rapport with the other band members [5]
- Reviewer saw the Dead with Jerry 37 times between 1987 and 1994 [8]
- Bobby was moving around energetically, and this was only the second show for this lineup together [12]
- Reviewer brought their uncle to his first concert, met online Dead & Company fan page friends there, and explored NYC [14]
- Reviewer prefers this setlist to the band's show they saw in Albany [7]
- Reviewer saw the Albany show, but says this Halloween show was the stronger one once the band got going [8]
- Reviewer argues this lineup should be judged on its own terms, not against past incarnations of the band [11]
- Reviewer calls it the best show they have seen from the various post-Jerry groups [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadandcompany2015-10-31.schoeps-44.flac24**: taped by A. Whitney; transferred by A. Whitney; source: Audience [1]. Also: The taper's Sonosax drained two 9-volt batteries per set, so the mics died around I Know You Rider; The release is a composite that keeps as much original material as viable and fills the gap from another taper's recording [1]
- **Dc20151031.14.eyesOfTheWorld**: taped by Joe D'Amico  ''AKA'' Joebeacon; source: 1st Set : Nakamichi CM-700's cp-1 w/-15db attenuation > Sony PCM-M10 24bit @ 44.1kHz > Korg Mr 2 2nd Set : Nakamichi CM-700's cp-1 w/-15db attenuation > Sony… [2]. Also: Commenter claims to be the taper, and objects that the recording was copied from etree and reposted without permission [13]
- **DeadCo2015.10.31.audmtx**: Source 1 is Joe D'Amico's Nakamichi CM-700 recording, run through a Sony PCM-M10 at 24-bit/44.1kHz; Source 2 is A. Whitney's Schoeps cardioid recording, run through a Sonosax SX-M2 into a Zoom H6 at 96/24 WAV [3]
